 Coming to XBOX Game Pass: Hela: of Mice & Magic, The Outlast Trials, Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2, and More
 Megan Spurr 
 Senior Community Lead, XBOX Game Pass 
 November 17, 2026 · 5 min read 
 Gather around, gamers! We’ve got more games coming your way, and there’s a little something for everyone. In the mood for a little magic? Terrifying trials? High-stakes sniper missions? We’ve got it all. So, let’s get right into the games!
 Available Today 
 Paw Patrol: Dino World (Cloud, Console, and PC) 
Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass
 Embark on a dino-sized action adventure in Paw Patrol Dino World ! Explore Dino Island, rescue dinosaurs, overcome obstacles using the Pups’ unique skills and put a stop to Mayor Humdinger’s chaos. Take on the adventure solo or team up with a friend in two-player co-op.
 Coming Soon 
 Call of the Elder Gods (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 
Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass
 Journey to the far corners of the Earth and unearth ancient horrors in this Lovecraftian narrative puzzle adventure and sequel to 2020’s critically acclaimed Call of the Sea .
 High on Life 2 (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 
Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass
 An intergalactic conspiracy threatens the fate of humanity! Team up with a wide cast of talking alien guns as you shoot, stab, and skate your way through exotic locales across the galaxy to take down the bad guys and save your favorite species (humans)! 
 Roadside Research (Game Preview) (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 18 
Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass
 Aliens have landed on Earth… to run a gas station. Play solo or up to 4 players doing human tasks to blend in. Scan, steal, and test various methods on customers while they stop by the gas station. Gather all data you can from humans without raising the suspicion meter too high, risk a visit from government officials.
 Black Jacket (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 19 
Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass
 21 or eternity? Black Jacket drops you into a purgatorial card game where restless souls wager their coins, and the ferryman waits for his cut. From Mi’pu’mi Games and Skystone Games ( Tiny Bookshop ) — a painterly, pitch-black spin on blackjack awaits. Cheating fully encouraged.
 Motorslice (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, Handheld, and PC) – November 24 
Now with Game Pass Premium; joining Game Pass Ultimate and PC Game Pass
 Play as the skilled (but seemingly ever-sleepy) slicer, P, and parkour through the ruins of a brutalist megastructure, climb massive bosses, and hunt down every piece of living construction equipment in this slice of life action-adventure with immaculate vibes.
 Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 (Cloud, Console, Handheld, and PC) – November 24 
Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass
 Sniper Ghost Warrior Contracts 2 is a modern warfare shooter set in the Middle East. Play as Raven, contract sniper assassin, as you take out a series of targets across a dramatic single-player campaign. With extreme-range shots exceeding 1000m, gear up for the most challenging entry to the series yet. 
 Arkheron (Game Preview) (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) – November 27 
Game Pass Ultimate, PC Game Pass
 Available on day one with XBOX Game Pass! Enter Arkheron , a fast-paced PvP action game where teams of three scale a mysterious Tower. Items are the heroes – imbued with abilities that define your strategy. Loot, adapt, and strategize your playstyle on the fly. Every decision alters how you fight and who you become. Ascension awaits. 
 The Outlast Trials (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) – December 1 
Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, PC Game Pass
 In The Outlast Trials , human guinea pigs are recruited by the Murkoff Corporation to test methods of brainwashing and mind control. In a world of fear and horror, your morals will be stretched to their limits, and your sanity crushed. Survive alongside friends or dare to face the experiments alone.
 Hela: of Mice & Magic (Cloud, XBOX Series X|S, and PC) – December 1 
Game Pass Ultimate, PC Game Pass
 Available on day one with XBOX Game Pass! See the world through the eyes of a brave little mouse in this enchanting 3D co-op adventure. Explore breathtaking landscapes inspired by Northern Sweden, solve puzzles, and be a force for good in a land where heartwarming storytelling and the beauty of nature intertwine.
 In-Game Benefits 
 World of Tanks Blitz – Monthly Bonus (PC) – December 1 
Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, Game Pass Essential, PC Game Pass
 Join World of Tanks Blitz ! Choose from 700+ historical and fantasy vehicles and battle across 30+ arenas in over 10 modes. Team up with friends, join clans, compete in tournaments, and earn rewards! Enjoy welcome rewards and monthly bundles with XBOX Game Pass!
 World of Tanks Modern Armor – XP Stock (Console) – December 1 
Game Pass Ultimate, Game Pass Premium, Game Pass Essential
 Stay ahead of the competition with this exclusive bundle, specially crafted for Game Pass subscribers! It’s packed with powerful rewards that will help you dominate even the toughest challenges, so don’t miss this chance to gear up and roll right into battle, Commander!
 Here’s what you’ll find in this bundle: 3 Days of Premium Account, x4 Commander XP Boosters (6), x3 Vehicle XP (6).
 Leaving November 30 
 The following games are leaving the Game Pass library soon. Don’t want the fun to end? Save on these games now before they leave Game Pass!
 Aliens: Dark Descent (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Banishers: Ghosts of New Eden (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 DreamWorks Gabby’s Dollhouse: Ready to Party (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Generation Zero (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Kill It With Fire! 2 (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Moving Out 2 (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Star Trucker (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Totally Reliable Delivery Service (Cloud, Console, and PC)
 Well, that should keep you busy for a while! Enjoy exploring the lineup – we hope you discover something new to love. Keep an eye on social for more news and updates, and we’ll catch you next time!
 Note: Games with a ‘Handheld’ designation represent those that are optimized for handheld play.
